context: Asuka lectures on social welfare systems.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: welfare lecture; vocabulary (年金/いただく/他人/向上/定め) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 年金は、社会の支え合いの仕組みです。
lines.en: Pensions are a system of mutual social support.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 誰が、年金を定めるんですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 法律で、額を定めています。
lines.en: The amount is set by law.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 他人のために、払うんですか?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 他人のためが、やがて自分を支えます。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 制度の向上には、何が要りますか?
lines.en: What does improving the system require?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 皆の理解を、いただくことが大切です。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 年金の向上、よく分かりました。
lines.style: satisfied adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
